certification.name: TryHackMe Security Analyst Level 1
certification.description: Entry-level security analyst certification covering computing foundations, cyber defence frameworks, threat detection, alert triage and case report writing. The exam combines multiple-choice questions with graded alert triage in a SOC simulator, completed within a 24-hour window.
certification.currency_note: USD figure ('from $349') taken from the comparison table on the official page; the exam details block showed a localized EUR 301; includes one free retake
